<function name="StripWeapons" parent="Player" type="classfunc">
	<description>Removes all weapons from a certain player</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
</function>

<example>
	<description>Removes all the weapons from the player with the ID 1</description>
	<code>Entity( 1 ):StripWeapons()</code>
	<output>Player 1 has no weapons anymore</output>

</example>
